meetings.title: Atlas kickoff
meetings.transcript:
[00:04] Priya Shah: Welcome everyone, this is the kickoff for Atlas, our new analytics product.
[00:21] Priya Shah: The goal today is to agree on scope, a rough price and a launch date.
[00:48] Marcus Lee: For pricing I would start the starter plan at 49 dollars a month.
[01:12] Dana Kim: That feels low given our hosting costs, but it is fine as a starting point.
[01:30] Priya Shah: Okay, let's go with 49 dollars for now and revisit it later.
[02:05] Marcus Lee: For the launch I think December 1st is realistic if we freeze features in early November.
[02:31] Priya Shah: Agreed, we are going with December 1st as the target launch date.
[03:02] Marcus Lee: I'll build the marketing landing page by the end of the month.
[03:40] Dana Kim: Onboarding needs a three step setup wizard so new users see value quickly.
[04:15] Priya Shah: Dana, can you draft the wizard screens before the design review?
[04:33] Dana Kim: Sure, I'll draft the wizard screens next week.
[05:10] Priya Shah: Great, that is everything for the kickoff, thanks all.

meetings.title: Atlas design review
meetings.transcript:
[00:05] Priya Shah: Let's review the onboarding wizard designs Dana prepared.
[00:30] Dana Kim: The wizard has three steps: connect a data source, pick a template, invite the team.
[01:05] Leo Park: Connecting the data source is the slow part, we should show a progress bar there.
[01:40] Dana Kim: Good idea, I will add a progress bar to step one.
[02:20] Priya Shah: Several customers asked for dark mode. Can we fit it into the launch?
[02:45] Leo Park: Dark mode touches every screen, it would add at least two weeks.
[03:10] Priya Shah: Then we decided to postpone dark mode to version two, after the launch.
[03:50] Dana Kim: The accessibility check found low contrast on the grey buttons, I will fix the colours.
[04:25] Priya Shah: Dana, please send the final Figma file to engineering by Friday.
[04:41] Dana Kim: Yes, I'll send the final Figma file on Friday.
[05:20] Leo Park: Once we have the Figma file I can start building the wizard.

meetings.title: Atlas pricing sync
meetings.transcript:
[00:03] Priya Shah: This sync is only about Atlas pricing, since hosting costs came in higher than planned.
[00:35] Marcus Lee: At 49 dollars a month we lose money on heavy users, the margin is negative.
[01:10] Priya Shah: What if we move the starter plan to 59 dollars a month?
[01:38] Marcus Lee: 59 dollars keeps us profitable and is still below the main competitor.
[02:02] Priya Shah: Okay, we agreed on 59 dollars a month for the starter plan, replacing the 49 dollar price.
[02:40] Marcus Lee: For the annual plan we should give a 20 percent discount to push yearly contracts.
[03:05] Priya Shah: Agreed, the annual plan gets a 20 percent discount.
[03:45] Marcus Lee: The free tier should be capped at three projects so it does not eat our hosting budget.
[04:10] Priya Shah: Fine, the free tier is capped at three projects.
[04:50] Marcus Lee: I'll update the pricing page and the billing settings this week.

meetings.title: Ops weekly
meetings.transcript:
[00:04] Sam Rivera: Ops weekly. First item is the database migration.
[00:32] Jordan Blake: We decided to migrate production to Postgres 18 on November 20th, during the low traffic window.
[01:05] Leo Park: The application side is ready, our tests already pass on Postgres 18.
[01:40] Sam Rivera: Second item is the on-call rotation for the holidays.
[02:02] Jordan Blake: I'll take the first on-call week, then Sam, then Leo.
[02:40] Sam Rivera: Third item, our monitoring vendor raised their pricing by forty percent.
[03:05] Jordan Blake: That blows our monitoring budget, we should look at alternatives.
[03:30] Jordan Blake: I'll compare quotes from Grafana Cloud and Datadog before the next ops weekly.
[04:10] Sam Rivera: Also, please write a rollback plan for the migration in case something breaks.
[04:28] Leo Park: I will write the rollback plan by Monday.

meetings.title: Atlas launch readiness
meetings.transcript:
[00:05] Priya Shah: This is the launch readiness check for Atlas.
[00:40] Leo Park: There is a bug in the Stripe webhook handler, some payments are recorded twice.
[01:12] Marcus Lee: We cannot launch with double charging, that would be a disaster for trust.
[01:45] Priya Shah: Then we are moving the launch from December 1st to December 8th because of the Stripe payment bug.
[02:20] Leo Park: I'll fix the Stripe webhook bug and add a test for duplicate events this week.
[03:00] Dana Kim: Beta users liked the setup wizard, but two of them got stuck picking a template.
[03:35] Dana Kim: I will add short descriptions under each template.
[04:10] Marcus Lee: I'll write the launch announcement email and send a draft to Priya by Thursday.
[04:50] Priya Shah: Good. So the new launch date is December 8th, everyone please update your plans.

meetings.title: Customer interview: Northwind
meetings.transcript:
[00:06] Priya Shah: Thanks for joining. We want to hear how Northwind uses the Atlas beta.
[00:30] Priya Shah: Northwind told us last week that exports are their biggest pain point.
[01:02] Dana Kim: Their main complaint is that CSV exports time out when a report has more than a million rows.
[01:40] Priya Shah: They also asked for single sign-on, SSO with Okta, before they can roll it out company wide.
[02:15] Dana Kim: Their renewal decision is in January, so SSO matters for the contract.
[02:50] Dana Kim: I'll ask Marcus to profile the CSV export job and find why it times out.
[03:30] Priya Shah: I'll put SSO on the roadmap for the first quarter and tell Northwind.
[04:05] Dana Kim: They liked the dashboards a lot, especially the scheduled email reports.

meetings.title: Ops weekly
meetings.transcript:
[00:03] Sam Rivera: Ops weekly. The migration rehearsal ran over the weekend.
[00:30] Jordan Blake: The rehearsal went fine, only one index rebuild was slow, about forty minutes.
[01:02] Sam Rivera: So we keep November 20th for the real Postgres 18 migration.
[01:40] Jordan Blake: On monitoring, I compared the quotes. Grafana Cloud is about half the price of Datadog.
[02:10] Sam Rivera: Then we decided to go with Grafana Cloud for monitoring and cancel the old vendor.
[02:45] Jordan Blake: I'll set up the Grafana Cloud dashboards and alerts before the migration.
[03:20] Sam Rivera: Last thing, the holiday on-call schedule is published in the wiki.
